players.product: optical components for transceivers & CPO (FAU, lens assemblies, isolators)

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record; board secretary and deputy general manager Chen Kairong): the shortage of bottleneck materials in H1 2026 affected the company's growth in that period; the tightness has since eased and is on an improving trend. Customer demand for passive optical components for high-speed modules keeps growing: the company expanded passive capacity in H1 2026 at customers' request while keeping utilization high, and is expanding capacity in multiple locations worldwide, adjusting it to demand, orders, materials and construction progress.

Management (IR record; board secretary and deputy general manager Chen Kairong): the FAU and ELS products the company supplies for CPO have achieved stable volume-production delivery, and the company has prepared ample capacity for customers' ramp; it continues design iterations and process improvement with customers. (Asked for a 2027 CPO shipment forecast, the company referred investors to analysts' estimates.)
